event.title: Tragic School Roof Collapse in Pakistan Claims Lives of Children and Teacher
event.canonical_title: Tragic School Roof Collapse in Pakistan Claims Lives of Children and Teacher
event.summary: A roof collapse at a private school in Peshawar, Pakistan, has resulted in the deaths of at least 28 to 35 individuals, primarily children, along with one teacher. The incident occurred on October 15, 2026, and more than 50 others were reported injured. Local authorities have indicated that the roof was structurally weak and had been overloaded due to ongoing construction work. The school's owner has been arrested as investigations continue.

timeline.title: Pakistan Initiates School Inspections After Fatal Roof Collapse
timeline.summary: Following a tragic roof collapse at a school in Peshawar that resulted in the deaths of 35 individuals, including 34 children, the Pakistani government has ordered inspections of school infrastructure. Families of the victims are demanding justice, claiming they had previously alerted authorities about the roof's poor condition. Initial reports indicate that the collapse may have been caused by weak infrastructure.
key_facts: 35 people killed in school roof collapse, including 34 children.
Families warned about the roof's leaking condition prior to the incident.
Initial reports suggest weak infrastructure as a potential cause.
